description: Build a cross-currency macro heatmap from indicator time series and return a matrix with latest values, recent changes, and z-scores. Returns analysis in the tool response.

currencies.description: Comma-separated 3-letter currency codes (lowercase preferred). Supported values include: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy.

indicators.description: Comma-separated indicator slugs to include in the matrix. Supported values include: any indicator slug the FXMacroData catalogue lists for the currency, for example inflation, gdp, policy_rate, unemployment.

name: macro_heatmap_task
title: Macro Heatmap Task
